target.name: cross-seed lower-tail risk optimization
target.outer_random_variable: Z_s(phi), where s is a complete training-seed draw and phi parameterizes an update rule
target.prohibited_substitution: episode-return CVaR is not evidence for, or an implementation of, cross-seed training-risk optimization

three_core_gates.mathematical_definition: A training-only, pre-outcome observable estimator of a lower-tail objective must be specified and identified as targeting Z_s(phi), rather than an episode-return proxy.
three_core_gates.training_only_interface: The current training interface must support independent complete seed replicas and the outer estimator without reading any evaluation tape, final seed label, or future trajectory information.
three_core_gates.affordable_cost: A minimally credible lower-tail outer estimate must fit a pre-authorized cost budget; its lower bound must include all independent full-training replicas required for one outer update.

cost_lower_bound.note: This is only one outer-gradient estimate, excludes base comparisons, validation, repeats, and all subsequent outer updates.

decision_rule: B2_P0_FEASIBLE only when all three core gates pass; otherwise B2_P0_NO_GO.
